# Quote the call before you're already at the door.

> Free calculator for mobile locksmiths: price one service call — lockout, rekey, lock install, or fob programming — with the after-hours premium and minimum service charge built in, then check whether today's calls hit your income goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
